policy-faq-gift-cards.text:
Frequently Asked Questions, Gift cards
Gift cards are digital and delivered by email, usually within minutes of purchase. They are available in 10, 25, 50, and 100 USD denominations. They never expire, carry no fees, and can be used across multiple orders. Gift cards cannot be refunded or exchanged for cash. To check a balance, contact support with the gift card code.

policy-returns-return-window.text:
Returns and Exchanges, Return window
You have 30 days from the delivery date to start a return. Items must be unworn and unused, with original tags attached and original packaging included. Items showing wear, wash, or outdoor use cannot be accepted.

policy-returns-refunds.text:
Returns and Exchanges, Refunds
Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive and inspect the return. Original shipping fees are not refunded unless the return is due to our error. You will receive a confirmation email when the refund is issued.

policy-returns-return-shipping-cost.text:
Returns and Exchanges, Return shipping cost
A flat 7.50 USD return shipping fee is deducted from your refund when you use our prepaid label. Prepaid labels are for US returns: Canadian customers ship returns at their own cost, so no fee is deducted. The fee is waived entirely if the item arrived damaged, defective, or not as ordered.

policy-returns-final-sale-items.text:
Returns and Exchanges, Final sale items
Gift cards and items marked FINAL SALE at checkout cannot be returned or exchanged. Ski wax and other consumables that have been opened are also non-returnable.

policy-shipping-domestic-shipping-option.text:
Shipping Policy, Domestic shipping options
Standard shipping is free on orders over 75 USD and 6.95 USD below that, arriving in 3 to 6 business days. Expedited shipping is 14.95 USD and arrives in 2 business days. Overnight shipping is 29.95 USD and arrives the next business day when the order is placed before the 12:00 pm MT cutoff.
